question: What lack of devotion disqualifies a person in the context of this instruction?
premises: Absence of devotion to the kula is specified.
Absence of devotion to the guru is also specified.
Both deficiencies are presented together as disqualifying conditions.
inference: One devoid of devotion to both the kula and the guru is disqualified in this context.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject to which these qualifiers apply is supplied by surrounding verses.
plain_english: But in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru...
